t:
The Gryphons are proud birds. It's like a combination of two royal creatures, a lion and an eagle. In the old era, they were almost everywhere, so they became one of the main types of transport for all kinds of nobility. There was no castle without a Gryphon in a special stable, and the imperial service of messengers also flew on Gryphons. And many coats of arms depicted them, too... There was even a clan - the Gryphon's Heart... Ah, I'll tell you about it some other time, let's stick to the point!

Attempts were made to improve them in every possible way, and all sorts of new species were bred. And then a Great Mage came up with something indescribable. He crossed a Gryphon and a mare - and created a Hippogriff! But in the wild, horses and Gryphons can't stand each other!

But as you understand, all this Gryphon abundance couldn't last forever. The world cracked in half, the rift began to boil - the Allods era began. And the Gryphons, which could fly long distances, immediately became unnecessary. No, they can still be useful but, as you understand, it's not the same these days...

Oh, the Xadaganian horse... You must have heard from me that the most convenient way to travel in the desert is by camel. But the desert is one thing, but the steppe and forest are quite another. Nezeb also understood this, and when he was preparing to conquer Kania, he ordered his servants to buy horses and breed new ones. It was where Igsh is now, the very border between the desert and the steppe.

Well, the people of Ugra also dealt with horses, so they quickly realized what it was all about. Instead of the huge heroic Kanian horses, they created a light and undemanding horse. It was very fast, perfect for sudden attacks.

Simply put, if it hadn't been for this horse, Xadagan wouldn't exist at all.

Oh, what a marvel, a flying board.

Another invention of wise engineers! I don’t know who invented them, either Dr. Burov with his assistant Motya, or Catherina herself...

There are so many modifications these days...

And some genius took parts from the Lightning Bolt and attached them to this board, so now it can shoot! Just imagine!

 I know many people like to race on these boards. Here at the Winter Resort, for example. Those who don't care for sleds can try to slide down the mountain on a board. What is it called? A snowboard, huh?

The Waterfolk and Aviaks on the Summer Atoll came up with even better ideas. They attached a sail to the board and started racing on the water, catching the wind. Amazing!

Hyena. Hmm, that animal is strange. It's neither a dog nor a cat, but sort of like its own thing. They live in the Izune steppes, and for some reason the Orcs are very fond of them.

Perhaps because they laugh, and the Orcs love to have fun. Anyway, the Orcs tamed hyenas and now use them as pets.

However, there are also special types of hyenas that are much bigger. So the Orcs decided to put a saddle on them... Why? The hyena is a smart animal, It can track down an enemy... So the hyenas became not only faithful "dogs", but also "horses" for the Orcs.

Lemurs are inhabitants of tropical islands where the Aviaks live. These creatures are intelligent enough to have their own ruler - imagine that! And their prince is now Juju, quite an interesting individual. I could talk for hours about his adventures with a gang of penguins from Isa, but that's a story for another day. The important thing now is that Juju can only be found on the tropical atoll. And only in July, during the Summer Flame Festival!

The Manabike is a device with an interesting history. The blueprints of its engines were gathering dust in the archives of the House de Ardeur for a long time until they were stolen by the brave Imperial spy Boleslav Fortochkin. Nezebgrad scientists have been working on the prototype for several years, hoping to create a high-speed courier transport for the front. Their efforts came to nothing, so the project was stowed away in the archives for a long time.

It would have continued to gather dust if one Goblin Banker hadn't learned about it. The famous businessman bought the patent from the Empire and completed the development at his own expense. Today the Manabike is the fastest vehicle in all of Sarnaut.

The Manabike comes with a special protective headgear - the Pilot's Helmet.

A motorcycle?

Another invention that will doom us all!

I heard they call it an iron horse, and I thought: what if the world turns into something that's entirely made of metal in a couple of centuries?

We will live in cities where houses are built with man-made stone, and there will be magic lamps all around, the kind the Elves have.

And these iron horses will run around these cities, roaring and howling?

A nightmare, if you think about it.

Well, it's a funny invention, an attempt to make a combat mechanism more popular among the masses by stripping it of most weapons and leaving only speed. And it worked: soon many people decided to get one for themselves and customized it. Mostly in the Empire, but the League also showed some interest.

An ogre?

Well, riding an ogre is almost the same as riding a crocodile. As long as it's full, it's safe. But once it gets hungry...

However, there are brave men who like a challenge: I'm talking about Demon Hunters, of course.

They were the first to breed ogres, so you have probably seen them during the war with the Architects.

And it seemed to make sense: the ogre is hardy and strong, and can carry a whole turret with the shooter.

After the war on Dane, they quickly put them into service, especially in the Imperial army where the ogres had been used before.

Of course, they didn’t give them an actual weapon, but even a stun gun worked well.

I know there are attempts to bring in trolls and Draconids, but so far the attempts have floundered.

Uh, crayfish? It has to be some kind of joke.

However, people ride all kinds of things now - why not ride crayfish? I remember a story about one distant island where people were very fond of sayings and proverbs, and there was a mountain with a sanctuary on it.

And in that sanctuary Cra'ay was worshiped. It was considered a great piece of luck if he started whistling, and it almost never happened.

Maybe that's where the idea was born that you should ride a giant crayfish on a Fool's Day? And Fool's Day is a holiday when it's customary to do things topsy-turvy. That's why jokers and pranksters decided it would be great if proud and brave warriors were sitting astride a crayfish that day.

They took one of these - red as though cooked - and cast a few spells. You cast a spell, and your horse turns into an illusion, looking exactly like that crayfish.

And if you have a sense of humor and don't mind riding an actual crayfish, you can go and buy one from the Holiday Committee Officials.

The rhinoceros is power. While the Stomper is a rare beast, rhinos are everywhere. They are fond of the steppes but wander to other lands as well.

It is said that in ancient times there lived Indrik the Beast, the father of all animals.

And many believe that it was a huge rhino, and not a unicorn or a Stomper.

This creature that weighs several tens of pounds is not just a vehicle - it's a weapon as it is. Apparently, that's why the Orcs love it so much, and if you've ever been to the Wild Isles, then you've had the opportunity to see that rhinos are the basis of their economy.

Now there are many different types of rhinos, to fit any taste.

Oh, what a miracle! Both a horse and a bird.

How does the song go? “And fly into the wild blue yonder On the wings of a slender flying horse". It's also believed that Pegasi can create a spring by striking the ground with their hooves. It gives powers of creativity to those who drink from it... But it's most likely fiction.

As for the rest, what can I say? One of the oldest mounts, a kind of classic that has gained popularity again. Bred by sorcerers in the old era and beloved by the Aoidoi.

By some twist of fate, a small herd of Pegasi settled on Ammer. Soon a new breed was created.

So if you happen to visit Ammer, you can see them there.

Rabbits and hares.

Oh. Well, that doesn't sound serious.

However, there are a lot of funny things in our life, which is quite important. So the idea of a mount that could move over rough terrain appealed to many.  In this regard, hares are no worse than other, less "cute" little animals.

And a huge hare, about two meters tall, can give you a kick you will remember for a while. But riding hares, however, are civilized animals - they are trained to do other things. To inspire others to fight, they beat the drums.

We don't know who was the first to take the hares into service. I think it was the Gibberlings - they tame all sorts of little animals. I know for sure that the elves of the House de Ardeur decided to improve the hares. Either they feed them something, or they put some kind of implants in their legs, but their hares jump higher than the roofs. Hare races are held in Irene.

Snakes or worms, collectively known as crawlers, are also amazing creatures. They are united, as you understand, by the way they move - on their bellies. As far as I know, wise magicians categorize them somehow, but to me it makes no difference whatsoever.

These incredible creatures once lived inside mountains or in the depths of the oceans, but the Cataclysm changed everything - it brought them to the brink of extinction. These worms and snakes can be found only in the most remote corners of the world.

The first to find worms were the Imperials who decided to use them for tunneling. For these purposes, a separate laboratory was created. However, it soon turned out that these creatures were not easy to control. A number of incidents confirmed that.

It was a little easier with sea snakes - finding these creatures was even more difficult, but taming them was easier. Soon the Free Traders started selling them everywhere.

Not so long ago, the war between the League and the Empire would not subside. Scientists and mages racked their brains over new blueprints and spells, trying to one-up their enemies.

This time, another leap in the development of combat mechanisms took place in the secret laboratory of the Death Plant. The rebels from among the Free Traders managed to complete an order that was supposed to greatly strengthen the position of the Empire on the frontiers. However, as a result of the intrigues of intelligence officers and saboteurs of the League, the secret schematics became... not so secret. Thus, the armies of both factions received a fundamentally new combat mechanism - the Spinner!

 It doesn't take damage when falling from a height, doesn't sink, doesn't slow down in water, and its powerful combat skills will make quick work of enemies.

In 1012, archaeologists discovered another treasury of the Junes. Among the ancient artifacts, they found something absolutely unprecedented - a huge combat machine designed in the image and likeness of a man. The power of June technology is well known to every hero of Sarnaut, but this mechanism looked better than the most complex golems. There was no doubt - the archaeologists managed to find one of the greatest inventions of the ancient race. More importantly, detailed blueprints for this device were stored in the treasury! Today, the League and the Empire are ready to arm themselves with a new type of military equipment known as the Titan!

The first model of the Titan was created by Kanian engineers, and it was this model that was later copied by the Free Traders.

Later a Colossus modification was created, an autonomous mechanism used by all engineers of Sarnaut these days.

Who is this Overlord, you ask? That's what Nihaz's minions call him - the God of Darkness who appeared in Sarnaut not so long ago. The throne is one of the implements of war that were granted to his apprentices. Many of our heroes were among them. Oh, this vehicle did not come from our world - it was created using technologies that our world does not even know. I know the Overlord's Servants themselves use it to fight against his enemies.

The Throne is an excellent defensive combat unit. Overlord's Throne is very difficult to destroy. Additionally, it has two modes: the Travel Mode and the Destruction Mode which allow the owner to easily change tactics on the battlefield.

You've heard of the bear before. And what kind of animal is the Ice Bear, you ask?

It's very simple - it's a polar bear, once an inhabitant of the polar regions. Now you can find these bears on the Frozen Frontier, Coldberg, or Ferris.

Unlike the brown Bear, this beast is wilder and more distrustful of people. However, it wasn't a problem for the Empire. They found a small population on one of the cold allods, and among them was a very friendly bear cub. They named him Umka.

Since then, the Ice Bears have become part of the Xadaganian armed forces. They are skilled swimmers and can easily move through snow and ice, so they were made the basis of the medical service of the Empire.

This time, the Elves and Kanians acted as the developers of the combat mechanism. The most ancient race of Sarnaut and master mechanics created a truly wonderful invention - the embodiment of magic and subtle engineering!

This creation is ideal for a sudden attack on the enemy, because the manned vehicle can become invisible and quickly move around the area. It also has abilities that can protect a friendly target from any damage and slow down enemies.

There are wolves and there are Grimwolves!

What's the difference? The size. There was once a fool in a distant kingdom - Ivan Snegov. He didn’t know anything at all - absolutely nothing. Everyone told him that.

And then Ivan met a wonderful Grimwolf who started helping him with everything. If you needed to save some princess or queen, you could rely on the faithful Grimwolf in everything. And it turned out that Ivan was not a fool at all - on the contrary, he was a lost prince.

Since then, Grimwolves appear here and there, helping people. Some of them are even trained to speak. Or maybe they all know how to speak - they just have no reason to do so.

Now wolves are the second most popular mount after a horse, and the reason is simple - besides a remarkable mind, they also have teeth: they can bite an enemy, and that’s that.

So you're interested in an archaeological exhibit.

The point is, Destree went extinct almost a thousand years ago. It was a horse that was bred in the old Kanian Empire when knights rode huge horses that could lift the weight of their armor.

That was a completely different era when it wasn't just the League and the Empire on Sarnaut, but a dozen other different kingdoms. The nobility participated in tournaments, and powerful horses cost insane amounts of money. But when the world broke up into allods, all this splendor came to an end.

However, I heard that it's very rare to find undead horses that belonged to those warriors.

There are different types of mounts! Horses are the most common ones. They are beautiful and well-built... Lions, and wolves, and gryphons, are more exotic. Who knows what animal will be tamed or domesticated another day... Mounts are for traveling. However, they are so charming!

Color Patterns change the color of your mount. You can buy them at the Boutique or find them in your adventures in Far Astral. Remember, once you get a pattern, it's yours forever, even if you get rid of the mount
Nowadays, a race horse is not a luxury but a means of transport!
Is there anything more beautiful than riding? I never stop enjoying it!
This is not a game. I will expose you to considerable danger. You need to drink a potion of power first.

The Kingdom of Nature is a secret allod that only the wardens can reach - the druids, animists, huntmasters and shamans. That is where we gather magic reagents that are used to brew special potions. I can teach you the secret of how to get there.
It is not that easy! You cannot walk or ride there. I will teach you a spell, which will teleport you directly to the Kingdom of Nature at any moment you like.

The postal service is one of civilization's greatest achievements. Thanks to a network of portals and hardworking postal workers, letters and packages arrive at their destinations without delay!
Postal workers can be found throughout all of the Allods. Each one is trained to provide the same quality of service and meet all of your mailing needs! You can send letters and packages to your friends and they will be delivered for a small fee. You can also check your mail and see if someone sent something to you.
Remember that letters and packages are stored for no longer than thirty days. You should check your mailbox from time to time so you don't lose important or valuable mail. Thank you for using the postal service and have a nice day!
Talk to Goblin Banker at the Boutique to be able to use mail from any point of Sarnaut.
Hm... This truly is an odd knife... Maybe I can find a few customers that would be interested in this.
If you accidentally create a scroll that you don't need, I can refund the components. Except for Amalgam and gold, of course.

Often times when you complete a task you'll learn something new about the world. It could be of incredible importance to the League, or even all of Sarnaut! For that reason I recommend you exercise extreme care and investigate every mystery! You'll be rewarded well for solving them.
If you run into a problem with an investigation, stop and think. Try to remember anything that you may have missed, and try to recall the places in which you may have been too lazy to look. Leave no stone unturned!
I also recommend that you visit the oracle often. Her gift for seeing the future is unique and it would be a terrible waste not to use it. Oh, and of course you must have friends! Ask them - they should be helpful!
What could be more fascinating than researching the world and uncovering all the secrets of the past? Maybe you'll be the one to reveal the most important secret in Sarnaut!

Ah, there we go! Your face seems vaguely familiar...
This is not the first time you've touched the mysteries of the past... And now you just wish to unlock the abilities granted to you for revealing the World Mysteries? Well then, pick the one you're interested in. But remember: only one Mystery is revealed for each Mystery Seal, and no more!
Here, take this manual, the tool, and the ingredients. If you need more, you can buy them from the master. They will also check your task.

If you have any souvenirs or decorations you don't need, don't hesitate to return them to me! Bring me Heart or Star Bunny Ears, a Flower Garland, Bunny or Cat Ears, a Firefly mask, a Gift of Love, a Patterned Shirt of the Amorous or Desire or Passion underwear, and I will trade them for Gifts of Admiration!

I'd love to trade, but you don't have anything that I'd accept! Bring me Heart or Star Bunny Ears, a Flower Garland, Bunny or Cat Ears, a Firefly mask, a Gift of Love, a Patterned Shirt of the Amorous or Desire or Passion underwear, and I will trade them for Gifts of Admiration!

Portals allow you to instantly teleport between different parts of Sarnaut. It's one of the most convenient ways to travel between parts of this broken world. Astral ships are frequently used to transport goods and larger groups of people, but portals are the method of choice for individual travelers.
In order to use a portal you must have already visited your destination point. You need to be imprinted with the portal's magical energy before you can teleport there or you might not come out in one piece! Talk to the Portal Keeper as soon as you discover a new portal.
Good luck and happy travels!
Thanks, I'm feeling much better now!

A guild is an organization that is founded and ran by citizens. Guild members can use it to socialize and work towards common goals together. If you're in a guild, you can be sure of help in times of trouble. There are many things you probably won't be able to do at all without the help of a guild.
I can help you found a new guild. To do that, you'll need to form a party of six friends that aren't in any guild yet. The party leader can then buy a Crystal of Unity from me and activate it to found a guild.
At that point, a name for the guild must be chosen. You can pick anything you like as long as the name is free of profanity and is not already being used by an existing guild.
As soon as the name has been selected and approved, I will enter the choice into my records. The party leader then becomes the guild leader while the other party members become its senior officers.
Later on the guild leader can accept new members, remove members, and promote or demote any of the members. They can also update the guild information and the guild's message of the day.
I strongly advise that you join a guild. Get your friends together and come see me. Remember, there is strength through unity!

t:
Pages from the Great Mage's Diary...
What a marvelous discovery it was! A diary of Danas, a Great Mage who once saved Skrakan's life... Unfortunately, the diary has been torn to separate pages. I have been collecting and trading them for ages!
If you happen to find such page, bring it to me.
The higher the page number is, the higher price I will offer.
I will trade 10 First Pages for 1 Second Page, 10 Second Pages for 1 Third Page, 10 Third Pages for 1 Fourth Page, and 3 Fourth Pages for 1 Fifth Page, the rarest of all!
Trade it for the Third Page from the Great Mage's Diary.
Trade it for the Fifth Page from the Great Mage's Diary.
Everyone who has achieved Greatness gets a reward: an Adaptive Shell Core.

quests: Pledge of Punishment: Path of Fire Heretics

t: I'm glad you are interested in the history of my family. Many of my ancestors provided fine examples to the younger generation. Let's take my father Aniel, who emerged as a hero of Kirah war. He saved Kirah from destruction during the demonic assault. Regretfully, he perished in the war against the Empire. Jasker himself faced him in a duel, and my father did not make it...
Helping is good, it’s always welcome.

Arrows of Passion are unique arrows - they strike right into the heart! Shoot an arrow into the one whose hand you want to win, and see how they light up with a smile. After that, everything depends on you!
But love should be mutual, right? That's why each arrow you shoot leaves a small present for you - a Gift of Admiration, which you can find in your Valuables.
But there is no love without trials, and Arrows of Passion are not given away for free. Fight, win and you will get them as trophies.
Oh, I almost forgot... the arrows have an unpredictable effect - sometimes they arouse strong emotions which blind the target completely. And if you are the lucky one to be blinded, come to me and I will help you.

Discords between the Church of Light and the Trinity Church started to emerge many years ago. In our days, followers of different churches only meet each other on a battlefield, but back then marriages between Kanians and Xadaganians were not that uncommon. You know, Xadaganian girls were crazy about elves! Eventually the religious controversy forced two churches to forbid mixed marriages.
Many hearts were broken... Can you imagine the terrible fate of unlucky lovers? But there was a brave man, a priest, who ignored the interdiction and continued to unite the loving hearts, keeping their secrets safe. Nobody knows if he was a Kanian or Xadaganian, and even his name is sunk into oblivion.
But his act of bravery is remembered! Nowadays both the League and the Empire are celebrating the Love Festival - holiday where there is no place for boredom and frustration! Find joy, celebrate and don't forget to present gifts of love to your beloved ones!
How did you manage to lose such a precious item? Fine, fine, here's your loss. Don't lose it ever again!
Oh yes, the letter, written on birch bark instead of paper. What's wrong with it?
Have you lost it? No problem, Vseslav was wise enough to have sent several copies. Here's one.
We were attacked by Demons! We have to destroy them!

Victory? Don't you see that Octhulhu ahead of us?!

Our shields are drained; we can't face an Octulhu. We've got to hide in the Anomaly and pray it won't follow us there. Hold on tight!

Ah!
Another letter that appeared from nowhere! I remember I saw it before!

Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
Don't stay in the Purgatory too long, or you might get stuck beyond this life forever!
Hm... I guess, some Astral perturbance broke the adjustment of the portal. No big deal, I'm going to make some changes, and you'll be able to teleport to Kingdom of Elements again.
Sure, I'll give you access! But other Portal Keepers are unaware of your visit. You have to meet them first, and after that you'll be able to use the portal whenever you need!
Well, do you feel better now? I am really good at it!
Aw, stop shouting! ‘S all gonna be done, not to worry.

Our orc shamans learned that I was alive - rumors spread quickly, after all. Perhaps some demonologist blurted it out, or they had a vision... doesn’t matter, really. They came to me. Cried, fell to their knees, hugged me! Pshaw!

“The hope of the orcs is alive again” and all that. I show them the door, meaning I don’t want any part of that. They change their tune then. “How about you help us train young orcs with special abilities, Skulnar?” they say. And I ask, “What kind of abilities?” It turns out our shamans have been watching those with highly developed perception. Well, those who can predict the future. They are supposed to be the descendants of that Legendary Orc but they’re nowhere as strong as he was. It’s just a smidge - they are luckier in cards and can dodge a stray arrow.

It was great at first. I taught them what I knew, things were pretty quiet. Trouble came last night. I was asleep and dreaming when suddenly there is a loud crash and screaming. I spring up - my students are all shaking... Those black creatures appeared, and they started screaming, and I realize they are still asleep. I can’t rouse them - they are having a nightmare but can’t wake up. You’re quite an expert in dreams now, can you do anything? I feel sorry for the guys, I’ve become quite attached.

Darkness! Darkness! DARKNESS!!! Death! Everything is on fire! This is the end! We are doomed! There’s no escape, darkness can’t be stopped!!

Ugh... I think it was a nightmare...
Oh... Yes... Need to go back... How did I end up here, anyway?

His wrath is terrifying! There’s no escape. The dark wave is higher than the city walls, higher than the mountains! Why didn’t you listen? Everything... is dead.

Aah...! It’s a dream, just a dream...
Dream... just a dream... Good... Need to get back. Where it’s safe.
You don't need Astralium yet. Come back when you need it.
How can anyone lose such thing as a goblin head? Alright, here's another.

Hmph... is that poisoned? I expect nothing but evil tricks from members of the League, you know.
 Although, we were all brought here together under extraordinary circumstances, so I suppose the normal rules don't apply. Give it here!

...For me? Ha! ...From the Gibberlings? Ha!
The world has certainly changed if Gibberlings are offering me ale. Well, I suppose it's worth the risk.
Pass it to me.

quests: A la santé de la Révélation !

t: Isn't this something, a stone hammer! Let me see it. Wow, it's pretty heavy. The Council says the Revelation will be ours soon and the League might as well be dead. It serves them right, but I hope I can bash a few with this hammer before we leave.
Hm... what's this? What a nice stone hammer, I should test it in battle! It's rather hard to lift it, but if I manage to hit someone with it they'll be a goner for sure!
Make sure you don't lose it again!
True Orcs make no alliances. Both the Empire and the League will soon die. The Lords say so, and the Orcs obey the Lords. The Orcs will never ally with the intruders.
My name is Hummer the Steel. I'm fixing what can be fixed and breaking what can be broken. What do you want?
Cool. I’ve got job for you, and it’s not about flowers.
Stop messing around! What are you doing here?
Hurrah! Hurrah! Hurrah! Now go away, you have no business here.
Are you kidding me? Get lost!

No one but us tailors can craft clothes from fabric or make leather cloaks. Besides, we possess knowledge of crafting Pectorales and necklaces.

Now, about the process itself. First, you need to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The threads required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Yes, you never know what you can loot, eysh! Embroidery, lace, buttons and beads can be used as they are, while fabric rolls have to be cut with scissors first.

The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and retailor the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you can work on at least two parts at a time. This isn't so hard to remember, zoor?
R-read a manual and buy a set of tools. I have all these!
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.

Weaponsmiths are always in demand: we make swords and spiked clubs, bows and crossbows, and even magic wands. But before you get down to crafting weapons, you'll have to practice making kitchen knives and simple hammers.

It is easier than it seems. Use weaponsmith's tools, learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the correct components. You can take coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore and cast in the molds you need. Parts will be harder to obtain. Rods, tips, bases, blades, braidings, additives, flux, granulations, enamels... All of that can be obtained by fighting enemies or bought from other heroes.

The process is really much like a game. You make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the others. You can only reforge each part twice, and you can work on at least two parts at a time.
R-read a manual and buy a set of tools. I have all these!
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.

An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. It's doubtlessly more rewarding to brew something good than just a portion of goo. Besides, even if you can't use it yourself, you can always sell it at an auction, eysh!

Remember to use only tools of the highest available quality. Pick up right herbs, and with a little luck, you might brew two different potions at once!

Use a herb as described in a recipe. If you ever see an unknown property, don't let it scare you off - it will surely work for the future!

No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements. You don't mind starting with that, zoor?

Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore and then cast it in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies. So do that as often as possible, eysh!

The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you can work on at least two parts at a time. This isn't so hard to remember, zoor?
Take a look at my goods!
Take a look at my goods!
Take a look at my goods!
Take a look at my goods!

And where is it now? Disappeared? Huh!

Stop fooling me. If something exists, it cannot just melt into thin air. Unless you travel to the past and make it never exist in the first place... But only gods can do that, not the likes of us.

Tell me, who did you meet there?

A Thrasher? It goes as a "stool" in my classification. Who else? A pyramide-like shooter? Alright, that's a "bulb". And a Colossus. No, I haven't seen remains of a Colossus before.

Well, keep on searching. I hope you will find something interesting.

When you raise your Flag of War you will then be able to attack members of the League. However, they will also be able to attack you. If you decide not to partake in the hostilities, simply refrain from attacking League soldiers for a 5 minutes, and your Flag will lower.
You also should know that when your Flag of War is raised here in the Holy Land your experience gain will increase by 10%. I strongly recommend that you aid the Empire and eradicate the League menace!
Keep in mind that damage and healing effects of your abilities will be reduced!
Ah yes, the scouts brought me an odd little item the other day. You're saying you lost it? Then take it and don't waste my time!

How terribly clumsy! You adventurers can't be trusted with anything! Adventure is all you think about!
But this is your lucky day, for I have found your mask. Here, take it and don't lose it again!

The God of Light promised Salvation only to his faithful servants. Sooner or later you will understand this and join us on your own volition, and not of necessity. As for others... Stupid creatures, that's all I can say!
And now you shall heed the vow of one who has been chosen for a new life. One who is expected in the new world! With our very lives, we, the loyal servants of Sarn, are bringing closer the moment when the walls of our lord's prison shall fall. The heathens shall dissolve in the astral without a trace, and the faithful shall live eternally in the new world full of Light and bliss!

Oh Great Sarn, bring wisdom into the erroneous mind of the creature standing before me! Enlighten his existence, reveal to him the path of the Truth! You have chosen this creature and brought it here! May it become a new soldier in your Holy Army! May your children, the Demons, bring it no harm! And may all your plans come true, oh Great Sarn, Lord of Light, Creator of all existence, both living and dead. We are your faithful servants and grateful children!
Illuminate our path, and may your wrath be upon us should we think wicked thoughts against those who have come here at your will.

Maria is afraid that these are all Nihaz's schemes. That is, his ordering you here to talk peace is but a ruse, while his real reason is power oriented. But I can't say I believe that... I am the patriarch, which means I can read human hearts. I see that you seek the Truth. And not the kind that gets served to you on a platter as one and only. No, the truth you seek is one that you can fully accept with your heart and soul. And we, the faithful servants of Sarn, are its sole keepers across the allods! We are the flame and you are but foolish moths. It was fate that brought you here. And it wasn't you who brought the plague here, I feel it. There's something else in play here. But what?

Ugh, this is a dreadful, cursed stone! No one knows how it came into our world or the kind of power that dwells within. But I do sense a hostile power inside, a power that opposes Sarn. But you know, this shard was supposed to be a sign intended for you.
ZIT Headquarters... Rumor has it that you were involved there, too. Is that true?
Tep's cultists brought the sarcophagus with the body of their idol and resurrected him. Do you remember that? A black stone just like this one helped Tep regain his flesh. Tep used the stone to absorb the Sparks' lifeforce, which transformed his body and cured his own Plague!
Tep has gone completely mad... It appears that he plans to capture all the Sparks in Sarnaut!
But how did this shard end up on the Wandering Island? If anyone can figure that part out, it's Nomarkh Ankh. He is a sage who has done thorough research on Tep's nature.
Where do you wish to go?
Before I can teleport you, clear the destination of enemy soldiers. You don't want to land on the heads of rampant draconids or wormfaces, do you?
Aha, here is the new victim... Oops, I mean my new assistant. So, shall we set your Spark loose?
Great! The more dea... I mean... contestants, the better!
Wow, you're so eager to sacrifice yourself on the altar of science! Wait, it's not the right time yet. I need to prepare for the experiment.

Your body will be guarded here in the camp, while your Spark will be released. So don't even think of destroying everything around you - your Spark is too fragile for that. You can only survive if you act quickly and inconspicuously!
You can't feed the insatiable Guardian? Our gracious Master allowed me to open a portal for you, but you must pay for it - this is a tradition everyone must respect.
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
Ask the Guardian about his needs

The League sharing potions with the Arisen? That's something new - thanks so much! All of us were asked to gather a Sign of the Chosen One and bring it to the City Council. I have no idea what it's for, but I really don't care. I never wanted to become the Chosen One. It's safer here in my lab.

Aha! What's this? I've never seen this recipe before! I wonder what effects it would have. Hm... evergreen leaves, blackbane flowers... Wow! I've never heard of such plants! I would give anything to have some, even a Sign of the Chosen One!
Make sure you don't lose it again!
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?

I will die before I say anything!
What? Rip out all the gears? From me?! Why you... Why you... Why, I'll...
Darn you anyway, ask! I have lived for many centuries, and I don't want to croak it again in my old age because of some greenhorn. So, what do you want to know?

Wow! I know what it is! They carried me into this time. Now I can return to my time or even somewhere else!
Thank you!

No, no, no!
Say no more! Words make no sense for the Time Wanderer. They are weightless like grains of sand and lost among the myriads of their brethren. I need the Ashes of the Past to continue my journey. Nothing else matters.
Hmm... But it's impossible! No, it can't be. Just because it can't.

To get a Free Traders' Contract you need to go to Coldberg and find Sigurd the Swindler. You'll have to earn his trust before he agrees to do business with you, though. I would suggest solving the current problems in his meteorite mines. To get to Coldberg, you should leave from Takalik Harbor in Eljune.
In Avilon you can find the leader of the Historians. You can get there from a dock at the Novograd Port. Once in Avilon, find Zayan and help him any way you can. When you're in his favor he should supply you with a Historians' Contract.
Finally, you can find the Demon Hunters in Dragon Ring. You can get there from the dock in eastern Coba Plateau. Find Nestor Golovanov and help him fight the demons on those allods. Then you should be rewarded with a Demon Hunters' Contract.
Fantastic! I will now accelerate your ship's construction or repairs. What should I do?

Greetings. Entering a trance is not required. Acquired the necessary information through neural messaging. Read at your leisure:

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

It is difficult to assess both the source of the information and what it refers to. I believe, however, that future events connected to you will have something to do with this... prediction. As far as the dead are concerned, we can already see the consequences. However, everything is done at the behest of our new authorities.

I will now enter a trance and peer into your future...
Your destiny lies to the south, in Igsh Military District. You will participate in many battles there.
Wow! I see three faces. They're all very high-ranking people! Elizaveta Rysina, Wrokag the Northwind, and Negus Kheket. They all want to see you, and each will give you an important mission.
Hm. I also see someone else. It's a strange man who appears to avoid the company of Imperial citizens. What could this mean...
Ah, I see! He's an upstart of some sort. It's important that you meet him or you'll miss some important events.
One last thing - be sure to mind your superiors and help them out when you can. Now go seek out your destiny!

Let's see what I can find out today... It appears the time has come for you to visit the ZIT Headquarters. You're lucky for it really is a beautiful place. I would have liked to stay there myself if it weren't for that quarrelsome Nomarkh Imhotep. But I digress...
Let's get back to your future. I see that something is amiss at the ZIT. You'll have to help the scientists out in many ways. It appears that even the main pyramid itself is having problems.
One last thing - you should be sure to talk with a Xadaganian man. Unfortunately, the vision isn't very clear and I can't tell you why. Just make sure you heed this advice!

Alright, I'll peer into your future straight away! Now let me concentrate...
The first person I see is Elizaveta Rysina. You should make sure to see her before you set off for your next destination - the Dead Sea!
You should also go see Wrokag. He has an important mission for you that could affect all Orcs.
This thread of fate seems to lead into the darkness, and I can't tell if it's broken or not.
Finally, I see an Arisen along the northern shore and an Orc in a deep dark place. They will play a big role in your destiny. It's essential that you find them!

Ah, your future is very easy to see right now. You need to visit two Orcs! The first is Wrokag, the Supreme Chief of the Orcs, and the second is Crazystorm of the Imperial Sentinels.
Both of them have an important mission for you, but they have very different motives. You should make sure to carry out both. The outcomes will be important to the entire Empire!

At this time I don't even need to enter a trance. I was told that Negus Kheket, Elizaveta Rysina, Wrokag, Crazystorm, and Yasker himself want to see you!
I'm not sure what's wrong, but it must be something very serious because they turned to me for a prediction. Your name was the one that appeared to me as a potential Imperial hero.
Go to Yasker's Tower and see what they need. They might find it hard to trust you at first. If they are not immediately convinced of your loyalty, then perhaps there are some tasks you need to complete first. Go and unravel this mystery!

I will now enter a deep trance and predict your destiny! Hm, your thread of fate looks very, very thin. In fact, it seems to be broken in multiple places. It appears you will soon visit the Holy Land and fight many difficult battles.
Unfortunately, there seems to be no other option for you. You must enter the thick of war. The Imperial General Kirill Sechin, the City Council agent Vlada Merinova, and the Imperial Colonel Braid the Bloodthirsty all need your help.
Make sure you also visit Yasker before your journey. He shall give you some information that you need to know before you brave the jungle.

I can see your thread of fate leading into the darkness of Tensess Temple. There you shall find many obstacles, including some strange magical barrier. Hm... I don't know if this is one obstacle you'll be able to overcome yet, but I sense that this is a mission you should start...
In any case, go and visit Anatoly Aldanov, the Imperial diplomat in Asee-Teph. He's going to play an important role in your destiny - that I know for sure. It will be a minor role, but one that is essential.

Let me peer into the future... Hm. Frankly, I have never seen such a tangled thread. It seems that you should go to Eljune, the eastern part of the Holy Land. There you will need to complete many tasks. You might want to write this down.
First of all, you need to visit Anatoly Aldanov again. He'll give you some instructions that I can't seem to make out. Just know that you should follow them.
Secondly, make sure to visit the forestfolk of Eljune. Their land is being invaded by lizardmen, and it appears that the identity of their leader will reveal many mysteries.
Third, visit Georgi Batalov. He's a famed Imperial commander and he will give you many, many assignments that will help the Empire out.
Let's see, what else... It seems you will need to aid the Historians as well. It appears that the facts you will uncover will remain important to you well into the future.
Finally, I see you helping many disciples of the Light. You need to see Irina Lazareva and the Great Ascetic Zosim Nikulin. Zosim is a Kanian, but he will not be your enemy. Make sure you take his words to heart.

I am now entering a deep trance... Hm, do you remember an Arisen by the name of Nomarkh Userkaf? It appears he will have an important mission for you! Remember where you met him and visit him right away.
From there you will go to Coba Plateau in the western part of the Holy Land. It seems you will have to associate with many who are not part of the League or the Empire. I see Historians, Prospectors, and even Demon Hunters. It is through them that you will discover where your fate leads.

So, you need my services once again? Very well. Let me enter a trance... Hm, it appears that you are destined to go to a very cold place. In fact, it's an allod named Coldberg. Perhaps you've already heard of this land - I feel that you may have already gotten orders to go there from some very important people.
Once you get to Coldberg you will meet with an important Orc. It appears that they have already entered your life sometime in the past, but I cannot say when. The threads are very tangled. I hope you can make sense of this puzzle and fulfill your destiny.

Your thread of fate is covered with your blood. And blood of thousands of creatures, all slain by the hand of the Unknown.
The Empire is counting on your loyalty!
It all clears up now. Visit Elizaveta Rysina once again. She will send you to vanquish some great monster in Avilon, but I sense you will come through this trial just fine.
These lines brings you to an Elven Historian while you're there. They seem to look like ancient June drawings.
What a mystery! You will have the chance to solve something that exciting.

Let me look into the future once again. I see... I see... wow, a dragon! It's a huge and majestic beast! I believe you are meant to meet with this amazing creature.
I also see an Orc. Her name is Koga the Crafty and she seems to be quite a fighter. However, she seems to have a small problem that she can't solve on her own. Unfortunately I don't have anything else to tell you. The rest you must solve by yourself.

I will now enter a deep trance and gather my powers... Oh, I see Yasker! He is... he is performing some amazing feat of strength. Wow, I never imagined he had such power. I suppose he is a Great Mage. Hm.
You should definitely listen to anything Yasker says, but that should go without saying. He is our leader after all! He shall send you to Yazes Shard where you will be tested many times.
I also sense that your missions will be of national importance. Make sure you keep your eyes open at all times. Any details could be important!

Alright, let me call upon my powers. Hm... If you and I weren't well acquainted right now I would probably call for a detachment of Yasker Hawks to arrest you. I can see that your thread will become interwoven with many demon-worshipping cultists.
I'm putting a lot of trust in you right now. I assume that there's a very good reason for this association. Actually, the more I look the more it becomes apparent that it will help the entire Empire - perhaps the entire world!
There is one more reason that I did not call the Hawks. It appears that Yasker himself will point you in this direction. I suggest you visit him and find out what it all means.

I don't need to use my powers to tell you what to do next. You need to see Yasker immediately! I was told to inform you about an important mission concerning Gorluxor's Tower.
It's a very dangerous place - more dangerous than anywhere you've been before. This is probably why I see your thread intertwined with many others. It seems you'll need to gather a small battalion to defeat the monsters inside.
I also see this tower lying in ruins one day... I believe that it's you who will help this come to pass. Now go and see that this vision is fulfilled!

Wait a minute, let me tune in to a mystical wave.
After Director was defeated, a veil of darkness fell from my eyes, and now I can make new predictions again. Well, well... Very unusual.
I see... death! You are lying in a metal coffin, and your body is cold and motionless...
I see two clouds rising above the horizon, carried by the wind and torn apart... All this happens again and again.
And I see what's behind the scenery, a Puppeteer who pulls the strings making everyone dance to his tunes. Could it be Director himself, returned from nonbeing?
I do not know. It may not be a lucky prediction, but this is the truth.
Take care!

Would you like me to lift the veil of time to see into the future? Concentrate and look me in the eye.

There's a thicket on this allod. Dark shadow crawling along, turning everything upside down, inside out... There's you fighting this shadow, this disease, so that it wouldn't spread.

I can see a ship, a huge one, I've never seen a ship so big before. Two women on the deck, one ginger-haired, the other raven-haired, both of them deceitful, both meaning to abuse you. Will it lead you to the good or to the bad?.. This, I do not know.

Many astral islands are on your path, and the path is long and winding...

There's more! Ancient Gods, born before the Light! They don't have much power now, but their help will tip the scale. And there are young Gods hard on their heels...

This is all I can see in your future. I hope it helps. Good bye.

You need a prediction again? Alright, let me concentrate...

Oh my! Dead as it is, my skin crawls at this sight. You are going to one cold place, all made of snow and ice. But you are not going to stay there for long. Then... I see strange things. As if your were going to the past... The further you go, the stranger it gets. It's all dark and grey around you with glimpses of blue light... This path leads you further than anyone has been before. Maybe even outside the Astral...

Also, you are going to meet a great power. I cannot define its intentions. It is neither good nor evil. It wants something, but I cannot see what it is. One thing I can tell for sure is that if we let it get what it wants, our lives will never be the same.

Need a professional prediction? Well, you came to the right place. Just a minute, I need to tune in...

Your adventure will start with a mad messenger. I can sense her presence - she's in Nezebgrad already. You will go to the place where she came from and see the reason of her madness for yourself.

I can see an allod where you've never been before. Green forests, mountains, fields. There stands... a fortress? And a big city. But now everything is on fire... Dead bodies everywhere. The smell of death and decomposition follows you wherever you go. You hear moans and cries, but louder than anything - the clanking of metal. You will witness a tragedy...

There is. No. War.

A strange alliance is waiting for you, and far more strange enemies, too. I've seen them already... They have no emotions, no soul. Full oblivion. Their power is beyond gods... It brings death not to us, but to our world order.

This is all I can see. The future is dark, and your way is a narrow path. Step carefully.

Ah, you again. Your fate is much more intriguing than that of my regular clients. Shall we start?

I can see your path leading you to lands that never existed before. You will be the first one in this world to step on a new allod and meet people whom no one has ever met... They are remarkable people, and they wield great power. Their lands are young and beautiful, and each grass blade on it is full of exuberant vitality. The heart of that allod is a pillar of pure light; a site of tremendous power.

But I can see darkness crawling up to that allod... And another darkness which is corroding it from the inside.

Be careful. Not everything in those lands is as beautiful as it seems.

Hello, hello. I knew you'd come. I have a prediction ready for you, didn't even have to attune myself. You're quite a regular.

Here it is.

Fate will take you to an allod with a bloody history so ancient that no one remembers it anymore. I see crimson roses and cliffs of ashes. Your allies have found shelter here, and you will respond to their call.

But your help will cost you dearly. This allod is like a chessboard for the Light and Darkness, and you are a pawn on it. Whether you die or promote on it, I can't say.

Yes, it's not a happy prediction, but that can't be helped. I'm not one to embellish reality...

Greetings.

My prediction is really simple this time. Skulnar the Fierce will contact you. I can't tell you the reason.
But there's one thing I do know. You and I will meet again.

I'm leaving Nezebgrad. I'm going to the Holy Land. Something troubles me. I need to check something.

You need to find Skulnar the Fierce. As far as I know, he's on Coldberg now.

I'm glad to see you again.

As you know, the latest news is not good.

I'm afraid we're dealing with the God of Darkness again. Fortunately, the darkness has dissipated a little.

Now, the predictions. Dominus Cosmos will be looking for you. Answer his call. Then... I see a ship. Looks like an Imperial one. It's far away... But you will find it. And with it, new challenges.

Then... You will return to Umoir. Meet some of your old acquaintances. I see armies of the dead... I can't see which side they are on.

Finally... The Citadel. Something unthinkable awaits you there. I'm sorry, that's all I can see right now.

Hmm. Calculating! Analyzing. Entering a trance state...

Wait until political battles start in Sarnaut. The Great Ball is starting soon.

You will attend it. Yasker will charge you with an important mission.

But I sense a threat. I see blurry shadows. Hmm, interesting. Beware of the harlequin! Beware of the viper lady!

I sense the Empire will be victorious. But there's another threat in the future!

Something terrible. Something threatening the very foundation of the Empire! Be careful!

I wanted to meet you myself. My ability to peer into the future has weakened! Someone is interfering with the timeline, and it's not the Observatory.

I suspect someone will contact you soon, so I'll tell you my personal prediction. The situation with the temporal anomalies has gotten out of hand. The leadership sanctioned the creation of a temporal stabilizer that will protect us against irresponsible time travelers!

You will be summoned to Suslanger. Once we worked there in the Copper Mines.

Today, it's a beautiful place. You can rest there like I used to before. New adventures await you there. This is what I saw:

Your decisions will affect the fate of the world. So choose wisely. Remember: trust must be earned. Beware of the Storm, because that Storm can carry away a camel. Beware of summer nights, because sometimes it's difficult to say the words you must say. And the most important thing: beware of the glint of gold, of grey cloaks and hidden blades!

Greetings. Ready for prediction. Entering a trance state... Seeing the future.

I see an imperial object. I believe this is Gates-3, so you are destined to visit Suslanger again. Now I see some fragments... Allods? Doesn't look like it. Now I see... something incomprehensible. The moon? Covered by seas and vegetation? Strange.

Could this be another world?

I guess you're going to visit it.

I see trees. A lot of trees. I sense danger. But also opportunities. Opportunities to learn more.

Then... The road forks. I believe you will have to make a choice that will determine your fate. At the end of the path, I see a figure. A dark figure that obscures the sky. Strange.

I don't know how it's going to end.

Hello there!
Do you need a prediction? Since my services are paid for by the government, you'll be able to learn about your future without paying a single copper! If you're confused about your life path or what you should be doing, I can send you in the right direction immediately!
What level prediction do you need?

Nezebgrad's magic field has changed a lot lately, and not in a good way.

Not only strong mages and prophets faced the consequences. Average citizens sensed it, too. The public paranoia started. People experience insomnia and depression.

On top of that, psychologically disturbed individuals appeared in town. They foretell the future and spell doom, and the problem is, the may be right.

To get a Free Traders' Contract you need to go to Coldberg and find Sigurd the Swindler. You'll have to earn his trust before he agrees to do business with you, though. I would suggest solving the current problems in his meteorite mines. To get to Coldberg, you should leave from Takalik Harbor in Eljune.
In Avilon you can find the leader of the Historians. You can get there from a dock at the Nezebgrad Port. Once in Avilon, find Zayan and help him any way you can. When you're in his favor he should supply you with a Historians' Contract.
Finally, find the Demon Hunters in Dragon Ring. You can get there from the dock in eastern Coba Plateau. Find Nestor Golovanov and help him fight the demons on those allods. Then you should be rewarded with a Demon Hunters' Contract.
Fantastic! I will now accelerate your ship's construction or repairs. What should I do?
A princess is as old as the prince will be when the princess is twice as old as the prince was when the princess' age was half the sum of their present age. How old are the prince and the princess?
My tales are the sweetest, and they come free. I entertain you all night just to be forgotten in the morning. Who am I?

We are getting closer to learning the secrets of this allod. And the places are getting darker. Look at this complex - there's so much in here. Numerous underground galleries, strange warehouses, production shops, laboratories... The Mechanoids created by that psycho are also roaming the place. Perhaps I should take a look around myself... Too bad we don't have enough time.

I'm here to warn you. And maybe give you a few pointers.

For me, all the events that are happening in there right now are the past. I know exactly what happened - and I can tell you what will happen. If you agree to go on this adventure. Or maybe it won't be you, but someone else? The future has many facets.

Of course, I won't stop you if you want to do everything on your own - after all, as one of our mutual acquaintances likes to say, the real Truth is attained only through one's own efforts and only such truth can be considered a World Mystery.

However, those efforts don't have to be strenuous - maybe you should come back here later when you're older and stronger...

Are you interested?

It's an inappropriate thing to say to a guest, especially one from the future. The fate of Sarnaut is decided here, and even the gods are involved, so I couldn't miss it. Well, do you want to know what kind of bait our God of Darkness hid in the center of the Dead City? The one that attracted the Wormfaces, demons, and Draconids there? It even drew the Servant of Tensess out of Purgatory.

We meet again!

Exciting, isn't it? The insidious sorceress Catherina fled - who knows what she's plotting now?

But you're probably wondering what will happen if you step onto the pier and go after the Eclipse?

If you want to know, you can just ask...

Hmm, what do we have here? A war?

So, you took the heroic path, defeated the enemy, and locked him up in his last refuge. The final onslaught is still ahead.

The Architects. Or rather, the Architect. I don't think the number matters here. They came from another world to bring Absolute Order. Renounce chaos, relinquish movement, relinquish free will, embrace stasis and ultimate... eternal... order.

The Architect has a collective mind. It's complex and lies beyond human comprehension. The basis of each combat unit is the Core. It contains part of the united consciousness. Everything else is just a shell that performs the necessary function. Destruction of living beings, for example.

The Architect's technologies are unknown. But there's one thing we know for sure. They can somehow absorb and transform any biological substance into graphite-like stone or possibly metal which they use to create their shells.

The Architect can build different shell configurations depending on the desired function. From a small "emitter" to a large siege structure... And most importantly, the Archonts.

But you probably want to know the ending. What happens if you enter the Fractal space?

I can't miss your first foray into the world of the Architects... Well, I don't know if it can be called a world. More like ordered space.

Do you believe the Sculptor? You'll have to trust his word.

So, do you want to know what will happen if you follow him to the Otherverse?
So our little hero has grown up and can handle everything on their own? Well, go on, then. I'm definitely not stopping you...

Heh, I have to observe the key events of your story. What if something goes wrong?

Here it is: another key fork and chapter of another story. It's also my story...

Oh, this is one of my favorite stories. First of all, I like the main character - eternally young, brave, curious, beautiful... Okay, let's stop there.

But this story intrigues me. It's very simple. There is evil and there are heroes who go out to fight this evil. No ambiguity, no grey areas.

Will you become its hero? You did. I saw it. Will you take the plunge now, or will you find out how it all ends from me?

It smells really bad in here...

Oh, these ancient tombs. Such a terrible layout. It's so hard to navigate.

We don't know who's buried here. It's good people if we're lucky, but what if it's someone wicked? A witch or a sorcerer?

Even after death, those still manage to cause all sorts of trouble.

And here's the heart of the Blight itself. Oh, bother...

The war is over, but we still need to deal with the consequences, right? At least only Dane was affected.

And what do we have here? More cultists, only this time they worship Order? A strange goblin prophesying a new order?

Let me tell you what others have said:

"I knew there was someone more powerful behind the fanatics and the Prophet. At first I thought it could be a Great Mage, but when I heard them mention the Sculptor - and nobody told me about him for some reason! - everything became clear. However, I can only speculate about the purpose of their experiments. And my speculations are not comforting at all.

As you can remember, faith is a great power which can literally move mountains. The Architects - or should I say the Architect - is using the power of self-assertion. He believes in himself, and he is unflinching in his faith in the special purpose of his mind. But the Sculptor has lost that power when he detached himself from the whole. Now he is trying to compensate by creating monsters who look like him and have infinite faith in his power.

You see what the problem is? If the Sculptor succeeds in creating a sentient chimera using human and Architect flesh, and that creature will be a believer, we will face a catastrophe comparable in scale to the invasion of Dane! This is what the Prophet and the fanatics want - to create an army of chimeras who know no doubt or hesitation and believe in the divinity of the Sculptor."

We need to prevent that before it turns into a global problem... You want to hear the story?

The Battle of Gods... It's an adventure. First you need to deal with the Wormfaces in their Temple. Then you travel to the Dead City and the Star Gates. Didn't I promise that we'd see each other again?

"Can one kill a god? Only those who survived the battle between Sarn and the Architect know the answer.

The gods have fallen. Mad Sarn died, defeated by the mighty Architect. The Architect has perished, overtaken by Chaos. Now Sarnaut is saved - or doomed.

The fate of the world rests on the shoulders of its children: the Kanians, Xadaganians, Orcs, Elves, and others born under the broken skies. Will they become the new gods? Or perhaps simple mortals can never comprehend the nature of divine power? Will they tame the Astral, or their only way to salvation lies outside Sarnaut? Whatever they are going to choose, it will be their own path and their burden...

This is the end. The end of history as we know it. Sarnaut will never be the same again. The greatest threat is over, but our greatest hope died with it.

Oh, the creators... Such a tremendous power, wasted. They could have created worlds, so beautiful and full of life, if one of them hadn't been so obsessed, and the other hadn't been so indifferent. Obsession and indifference... Two sides of the same coin. We can only hope that those who will come after them can achieve a balance.

People need their gods, and if there are no gods, they create them. Maybe one day you'll become the next master of destinies? Who knows, who knows..."

The Wormfaces were shocked when their champion was defeated.

"I can't believe it... You defeated Teumim. You are strong... I won't stand in the way of the strongest, but I'm warning you: what you are looking for will only bring you trouble. The Bowl of Origins grants power, but in the hands of the unworthy it can plunge the world into chaos.

To be able to touch the Bowl, we spend years in meditation, clearing our mind and ridding ourselves of pride so we don't accidentally release the power contained in it. Only then can we touch the power of the Origins. The Guard protects the Bowl from the weak-willed. Do you want to take it? Go ahead! Take it! We will bury your broken bodies in this temple as a warning: that's what pride does to a soul!

Another golem is waiting for you - the last of the June guards.

"Looks like a great battle awaits you. I'm sorry but I'll wait here - I have no right to risk my life fighting June scrap metal. Besides, someone has to sing songs about your heroic exploits when it's all over," said Klavdia.

Fortunately, even ancient June technology has vulnerabilities:

"This thing is huge... I didn't know June technology was so advanced. It looks like they built that monstrosity not long before they died. A lot of effort went into it. Alas, it didn't save them from the divine curse.

But we did a good job! Now we have the keys to the Seals, and I can weaken them just enough to let Sarn into our world but keep him from destroying it."
